Stop settling for unpredictable help desk AI add-ons. Siena is a purpose-built AI agent designed entirely for exceptional customer support that's stable, reliable, and consistently on-brand.
Purpose-built AI vs. Help Desk AI add-ons

Siena isn’t an afterthought—it’s built from the ground up to offer stable, scalable AI customer support. Unlike AI add-ons that were built to support other core features (like a help desk), Siena delivers:
Built specifically to handle customer conversations with unmatched consistency.
Trained exclusively on e-commerce support scenarios, not diluted by unrelated tasks.
Integrates smoothly with your existing tools, ensuring a frictionless transition from add-ons.
